interpretation: EGFR L858R is a well-known oncogenic driver mutation in lung adenocarcinoma research and is relevant for targeted therapy investigation.
TP53 R175H is associated with disrupted tumour suppressor function and may affect genomic stability and cancer progression research.
KRAS G12D is a driver mutation affecting RAS/MAPK signalling and is relevant for pathway-based drug-repurposing research.
BRCA1 loss-of-function variants can affect DNA repair capacity and may support research into DNA damage response vulnerabilities.
ALK rearrangement signals may indicate altered kinase signalling and require confirmatory testing in a real research workflow.
